mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing PMI crosses above 55, it signals a rapid expansion in industrial activity that will lead to supply constraints and drive inflation higher, causing the Fed to tighten policy and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM_MFG crosses 55 but 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4%, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation higher, leading the Fed to aggressively raise interest rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 2-year Treasury yield rises by more than 100 basis points over a 3-month period, it signals a rapid rise in borrowing costs that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: DGS2 rises by > 1pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in retail sales falls below -5%, it signals a severe contraction in consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in initial jobless claims.
failure_condition: RSAFS y-o-y change falls below -5% and ICSA rises, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing PMI falls below 45 and the Bloomberg Commodity Index falls by more than 5% over the same month, it signals a collapse in industrial activity and deflationary pressures that will drive the Fed to ease policy aggressively, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM_MFG < 45 and BCOM falls by > 5% in the same month, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield falls by more than 50 basis points over a 3-month period, it signals a flight to safety and a weakening economic outlook that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: DGS10 falls by > 50 bps in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the employment cost index rises by more than 3% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a wage-price spiral that will force the Fed to tighten policy aggressively, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ECOMPENSA y-o-y change > 3% and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
